thread:
darya: heads up - CI noticed a subtle uptick in unassigned leads right after the enrichment workers autoscaled. SLA dashboard nudged. anyone from routing team awake? :coffee:
owen: saw it. traces show enrichment latency sometimes returning after rr slot window; leads are hitting the fallback unassigned path.
rebecca: we recently tightened the enrich TTL to 20s to reduce hold time. this makes the race against a 30s rr slot tighter and more fragile on backend blips.
hubspot-bot: alert: inbound.handoff.unassigned_rate=4.9% window=10m source=hs-sync
odds: maybe add a "guardrail" that preserves owner mapping attempts for a short safety period instead of immediate fallthrough. keep the lead in a transient queue and mark with snooze:awaiting_enrich.
owen: proposal: transient_guard (ttl=75s) where router holds the lead and retries enrich once after 10s. if enrich succeeds, attach owner and continue; if not, route to overflow with tag stale-owner-protect. also emit metric inbound.handoff.guard_hold_count.
darya: good. prefer "snooze" wording in HS so SDR dashboards can filter. also want a partial_defer flag so we don't write owner to SF until enrich passes QC. that prevents churn.
rebecca: implementation notes: router change small. state transitions: RECEIVE -> GUARD_HOLD -> FALLBACK. add a deferred_owner_write boolean. this avoids stomping later.
ops-bot: deploy.safety: run canary 3% for 30m; rollback triggers: a) unassigned_rate > baseline*2 b) overall assign_latency_p95 > baseline*1.8
owen: quick canary snippet for router config:```
router.guardrails.enabled=true
router.guardrails.ttl_seconds=75
router.guardrails.retry_after_seconds=10
router.guardrails.defer_owner_write=true
canary.percent=3
```
darya: add heartbeat tweak: handoff-heartbeat should report guard_hold_count and delta_unassigned per minute so we see regressions fast. also add a HubSpot saved filter: property=snooze:awaiting_enrich to measure affected leads.
rebecca: on overflow rule: tag leads with stale-owner-protect and delay outbound sequences for 45m. after that we either attach a placeholder owner or surface to SDRs with a quality note. avoids spamming with incomplete profiles.
owen: cross-check with SF sync: if deferred_owner_write=true we must queue the owner write until either enrich completes or after 45m fallback. prevent partial writes that confuse commission rules.
darya: owners and tasks: owen -> code + canary rollout, rebecca -> HS & SF mapping doc + saved filters, me -> update SLA playbook and notify CSMs, ops -> add heartbeat metrics. target: canary start at 12:10 UTC, 30m window. rollback window 15m strict.
hubspot-bot: deploy.scheduled: canary=3% scheduled_by=darya start=3098765460
rebecca: small UX note: add UI flag in SDR dashboard to hide snoozed leads by default and allow a toggle to view awaiting_enrich leads. will file a quick JIRA.
ops-bot: checklist for rollout: 1) enable metrics before canary 2) run canary at 3% 3) monitor guard_hold_count and unassigned_rate 4) commit or rollback after 30m
darya: thanks team. long-term follow-up: increase enrichment replicas and add a circuit-breaker + backoff so we don't rely only on guardrails. also run a small chaos test against db replicas to validate. ping here with canary deltas. :rocket:
